screen_specs.title: Media activity
screen_specs.implementation_note: Parent shows only authorized children; default last 7 days; server cursor pagination, no server media file links.

screen_specs.title: Choose a child
screen_specs.implementation_note: Accessible dropdown filters using child name + masked ID; no child from another family. Parent changes clear cursor.

screen_specs.title: Date range
screen_specs.implementation_note: Timezone localized, to-exclusive UTC server boundary; reject reversed/oversized/retention-exceeding queries.

screen_specs.title: Filter results
screen_specs.implementation_note: Filters are server-side and intersect date and child scopes; page cursor resets upon any filter change.

screen_specs.title: Session details
screen_specs.implementation_note: VIEWED_ONLY only if parent display/playback receipt verified. Live-only file_size_bytes is NULL.

screen_specs.title: Saved recording details
screen_specs.implementation_note: Historical receipt cannot prove parent file remains after deletion; do not provide server download links.

screen_specs.title: Why did it fail?
screen_specs.implementation_note: Show exact OS error only when verified. Phone call/mic-used attribution cannot be invented.

screen_specs.title: No matching activity
screen_specs.implementation_note: Empty is distinct from unauthorized, failed server request, and offline device.

screen_specs.title: Historical activity offline
screen_specs.implementation_note: Read-only history does not wake child. Never infer a sensor-specific failure from an offline phone.

screen_specs.title: Browse more activity
screen_specs.implementation_note: Stable sort (request_at DESC, ID DESC) and signed cursors with previous/next; no duplicate rows on changes.

screen_specs.title: Access not available
screen_specs.implementation_note: No cross-family ID enumeration and expired guardian grants invalidate cached pages.

screen_specs.title: Administrator sign-in
screen_specs.implementation_note: Separate admin JWT audience, MFA, short TTL, server-side role and case. No media log data before sign-in.

screen_specs.title: Operations overview
screen_specs.implementation_note: No named children in routine support dashboard. Hide aggregate when small-number inference risky.

screen_specs.title: Request case-based access
screen_specs.implementation_note: Case/purpose scope server-issued, expiring; ordinary operator role cannot grant itself universal search.

screen_specs.title: Media activity explorer
screen_specs.implementation_note: Parent/child names resolved read-time under active scope; filter intersection + max page size and stable cursor pagination.

screen_specs.title: Search parent accounts
screen_specs.implementation_note: Name/ID autocomplete debounced and server-scope filtered; lookup itself recorded in access audit.

screen_specs.title: Search children
screen_specs.implementation_note: Child parent relationship validated server-side; dropdown may not reveal siblings outside explicit case.

screen_specs.title: Media record details
screen_specs.implementation_note: Admin cannot replay, download, thumbnail or access media; viewed requires parent display/playback receipt.

screen_specs.title: Failure reason & evidence
screen_specs.implementation_note: No raw exception texts or third-party call data. Distinguish verified reason source from unknown context.

screen_specs.title: No results or no access
screen_specs.implementation_note: UI distinguishes zero result/403/401/422/429, no identity leaks in error or suggestions.

screen_specs.title: Pagination and retry
screen_specs.implementation_note: Keyset cursor with previous/next history, bounded page size max 100, cancellation and retry; scope checked every page.

screen_specs.title: Administrator access audit
screen_specs.implementation_note: Search, suggestions, detail reads and export attempts write audit; fail closed if audit not persisted.

screen_specs.title: Privacy and retention gates
screen_specs.implementation_note: Privacy-approved retention TTLs TBD; operator read-only unless separate signed change; backup/deletion protection.

screen_specs.title: Session expired
screen_specs.implementation_note: 401 and session expiry require step-up; no cached child rows displayed on expired screen.

screen_specs.title: Access denied
screen_specs.implementation_note: 403 must not reveal existence of target parent/child. Audit failed attempt. No admin superuser default bypass.

screen_specs.title: Controlled export request
screen_specs.implementation_note: Download/export disabled by default, requires case-bound dual control, audit and DLP review.

screen_specs.title: Role and case assignment
screen_specs.implementation_note: Manage role grants via separate governed workflow; root does not automatically receive child metadata rights.

screen_specs.title: Audit service unavailable
screen_specs.implementation_note: Fail closed for detailed access if independent admin-access audit cannot durably append.
